summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of 4 new finance features: Recurring Expenses, Favorite Accounts, Vendor Commission Statement PDF, and Bank Reconciliation. All 26 tests passed (7 basic + 8 audit fixes + 11 deep scenarios).
passed_tests: Recurring Expenses: Create monthly rule with day_of_month=5, amount=12345 → response includes id, next_run_date, run_count=0
Recurring Expenses: run-now posts balanced JE (DR expense / CR bank) with source=recurring_expense
Recurring Expenses: Idempotent — same-day run-now returns journal=null
Recurring Expenses: Scan endpoint processes all rules with next_run_date <= today, advances next_run_date, increments run_count
Recurring Expenses: No duplicate posting (idempotency verified)
Recurring Expenses: PATCH active=false excludes from scan; PATCH active=true includes again
Recurring Expenses: DELETE removes rule but historic JEs remain (audit trail preserved)
Recurring Expenses: Past start_date triggers catch-up posting (posts JEs for missed periods)
Recurring Expenses: Weekly frequency works correctly
Favorite Accounts: POST /api/favorite-accounts adds to per-user list
Favorite Accounts: Duplicate POST keeps list stable (no double entries)
Favorite Accounts: DELETE /api/favorite-accounts/{id} removes it
Favorite Accounts: GET returns {account_ids, accounts[]} with full account docs sorted in insertion order
Favorite Accounts: Two users on same tenant have separate favorites (personal, not shared)
Vendor Statement PDF: GET /api/vendors/{vid}/commission-statement.pdf returns Content-Type application/pdf
Vendor Statement PDF: Response starts with %PDF, size > 500 bytes
Vendor Statement PDF: Works with vendors that have zero commissions
Bank Reconciliation: POST /api/bank-reconciliation/{bank_id}/upload with CSV file — rows parsed correctly
Bank Reconciliation: Debit → negative, Credit → positive conversion works
Bank Reconciliation: Auto-matches JE lines on bank account within ±3 days at ±0.5 tolerance
Bank Reconciliation: Returns {rows_saved, auto_matched}
Bank Reconciliation: CSV with bracketed negatives '(1,200)' parsed correctly as -1200
Bank Reconciliation: CSV with non-ISO dates (DD/MM/YYYY, DD-MM-YYYY) normalized to ISO format
Bank Reconciliation: GET /api/bank-reconciliation/{bank_id}/rows returns {rows[], counts{unmatched, auto_matched, matched, reconciled, ignored}}
Bank Reconciliation: Status filter parameter works
Bank Reconciliation: POST /api/bank-reconciliation/rows/{row_id}/reconcile flips status → reconciled
Bank Reconciliation: POST /api/bank-reconciliation/rows/{row_id}/create-je creates balanced JE via _post_journal
Bank Reconciliation: Positive row amount → DR bank / CR income; Negative row amount → DR expense / CR bank
Bank Reconciliation: Row status flips to matched with matched_journal_id set after create-je
Bank Reconciliation: POST /api/bank-reconciliation/rows/{row_id}/ignore sets status=ignored
Bank Reconciliation: RBAC — Accountant (has finance.*) can upload/reconcile/create-je
Bank Reconciliation: GET /api/bank-reconciliation/summary returns {accounts:[{account, unmatched, matched, auto_matched, reconciled, ignored}]}
All JEs are balanced (DR=CR) — verified across all features
No duplicate postings — idempotency verified for recurring expenses and bank rec
Audit trail preserved — DELETE recurring rule keeps historic JEs
Payment reversal resets invoice to 'sent' and clears journal_id
Milestone reversal resets milestone to 'pending' and clears journal_id
RBAC uses finance.* permissions — Accountant can create accounts
Commission receipt uses central engine, JE is balanced and linked to project
Trial Balance includes opening balances and stays balanced
Journal search and pagination work correctly
Loan deletion reverses JE instead of hard-deleting
Today's collections includes invoice_payment JEs
